introHtml: Custom baseball mouse pads bring the energy of America's favorite pastime to any desk. Whether you're outfitting a sales team with branded gear for a client meeting or creating giveaways for a company softball tournament, these mouse pads offer a durable, non-slip surface paired with full-color imprinting of your logo or design. The baseball-themed shape and stitching details make them a memorable promotional item that stands out from standard rectangular pads.
